Alex: Ok team — we're bringing up a new eu-central-1 Dedicated cluster this week. Need an observability provisioning runbook (logs/metrics/traces, dashboards, alerts). Need bootstrap steps, validation checks, and handoff checklist. Who can own?
Maria (infra): I can own the runbook. I'll draft helm/terraform steps, validation queries, and alert templates. Will keep it minimal and actionable.
Alex: Perfect. Priorities: GPU node provisioning checks, scheduler Pending pods, GPU memory pressure, KV cache hit/miss rate, prefix cache regen counts, network egress cost meter. Also set sensible retention/TTL for logs/traces.
Maria (infra): Draft below — please comment. I'll push to infra-runbooks after quick review.
Maria (infra): ```bash
# bootstrap observability namespace + RBAC
kubectl create ns observability || true
helm repo add grafana https://grafana.github.io/helm-charts
helm repo add prometheus-community https://prometheus-community.github.io/helm-charts
helm repo update

# install Prometheus (k8s)
helm upgrade --install prom prometheus-community/prometheus 
  --namespace observability 
  -f values/prom-values.yaml

# install Loki + Fluentbit for logs
helm upgrade --install loki grafana/loki -n observability -f values/loki-values.yaml
helm upgrade --install fluentbit stable/fluent-bit -n observability -f values/fluentbit-values.yaml

# install Tempo (traces)
helm upgrade --install tempo grafana/tempo -n observability -f values/tempo-values.yaml

# install Grafana and provision dashboards via sidecar
helm upgrade --install grafana grafana/grafana -n observability -f values/grafana-values.yaml
```
Maria (infra): Key values knobs to check in values/*.yaml: storageClass (S3/objstore), retention_days, sample_rate (tempo), max_chunk_age (loki), resource requests/limits for collectors, and persistent volume sizes.
Sam: For retention — what's recommended for eu cluster to keep costs sane?
Maria (infra): Recommend defaults: logs (Loki): 14 days (hot), archive to S3 lifecycle 90 days; metrics (Prometheus): 30d TSDB retention for node/gpu metrics, remote_write to long-term storage for queries >30d; traces (Tempo): 7 days raw, 30 days if using sampled remote write. Also enable chunk compression and Loki index TTL pruning.
Jun: How do we validate GPU-specific signals? Any queries you can paste?
Maria (infra): Add these validation checks (PromQL / Loki).
Maria (infra): PromQL snippets:
```
# GPU memory pressure: fraction of memory used per GPU node
(sum(nvidia_gpu_memory_used_bytes) by (instance)) / (sum(nvidia_gpu_memory_total_bytes) by (instance))

# GPU utilization short window (5m avg)
avg_over_time(nvidia_gpu_utilization_percent[5m]) > 80

# Pod pending due to resources
count(kube_pod_status_phase{phase="Pending"}) by (namespace)
```
Maria (infra): Loki queries for app log errors:
```
{app="infer-server"} |= "OOM" or |= "out of memory" | json | count_over_time({app="infer-server"}[15m])
```
Maria (infra): Tempo validation: request traces sampled at entry points, check 95p latency per model route: use Jaeger/Tempo UI or query if using analytics. Also validate parent/child spans for cache hits vs miss paths.
Alex: Alerts we should template? Keep simple and handoff-friendly.
Maria (infra): Starter PrometheusRule examples:
```yaml
apiVersion: monitoring.coreos.com/v1
kind: PrometheusRule
metadata:
  name: redwood-observability-rules
  namespace: observability
spec:
  groups:
  - name: gpu.rules
    rules:
    - alert: GPUHighMemoryUsage
      expr: (sum(nvidia_gpu_memory_used_bytes) by (instance)) / (sum(nvidia_gpu_memory_total_bytes) by (instance)) > 0.9
      for: 5m
      labels:
        severity: critical
      annotations:
        summary: "GPU memory > 90% on {{ $labels.instance }}"
        runbook: "https://internal.redwood/runbooks/obs/gpu-high-mem"

    - alert: PodPendingDueToResources
      expr: count(kube_pod_status_phase{phase=\"Pending\"}) > 5
      for: 10m
      labels:
        severity: warning
```
Maria (infra): PagerDuty escalation: Severity=critical -> paging oncall; warning -> Slack #eng-oncall with runbook link. Attach playbook snippet in runbook.
OncallOps: For handoff, include a list of smoke tests:
- prometheus: /graph -> targets UP
- grafana: login + sample dashboard loads
- loki: run a test log through fluentbit and query it
- tempo: submit a synthetic trace via loader and verify retention/sampling
- alerts: trigger a test alert (simulate high GPU mem) and verify PD ticket created
DevOps Bot: apply started: helm upgrade --install prom ... (job id: deploy-obs-332)
Sam: For cost alerts: can we add an S3 egress/ingress budget alert and monthly estimate metric?
Maria (infra): Yes — we've got a CloudBilling exporter. Add these two: monthly_estimated_cost > $X (per-team threshold) and s3_requests_cost spikes > baseline * 2. We'll include runbook sections for budget ownership.
Alex: Nice. Final checklist for handoff to OncallOps:
- PR merged to infra-runbooks with values/*.yaml and alert rules (owner: Maria)
- Grafana provisioning folder added with dashboard JSON (UIDs noted)
- S3 lifecycle + bucket policy applied (security review done)
- PD service created and escalation policy wired
- Run smoke tests & attach results to PR
